consentModal.title: We value your privacy
consentModal.description: We use essential cookies to make this site work and optional analytics cookies to improve your experience. You can change your choice anytime.
consentModal.playgroundNote: The live playground on form0.dev runs on StackBlitz, which sets its own cookies; it loads only if you allow it and start it.
consentModal.revisionMessage: Since your last choice, we added a Playground (StackBlitz) option.

sections.title: Use of cookies
sections.description: Select which categories to allow. Essential cookies are always on because the site will not function without them.

sections.title: Strictly necessary
sections.description: Required for core features like language and theme.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.description: Helps us understand traffic and usage.

sections.title: Playground (StackBlitz)
sections.description: Lets you start the live playground on form0.dev. Starting it loads StackBlitz, a US service that sets its own cookies and runs analytics from Google, Segment and Mixpanel. To remove cookies StackBlitz already set, use your browser settings.

sections.title: Marketing
sections.description: Used to show relevant campaigns and measure performance.
